recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No FHIR core source follow-up is needed for the original FHIR-5939 URI defects unless a new validation concern is raised separately.
issue_request: FHIR-5939 was a Published/Persuasive change request reporting that the Composition discharge summary integrated example used non-URI or malformed system values: www.loinc.org, nhi, sys, and inconsistent or malformed SNOMED URLs.
initial_application: The Jira comments said the issue was fixed in SVN 4744 and the remaining LOINC detail in SVN 4758. Git-svn history confirms 64fc0a81b0 (build@4744) removed the non-URI Patient identifier system and corrected the malformed SNOMED and sys values, while db55db7414 (build@4758) changed www.loinc.org to http://loinc.org in document-example-dischargesummary.xml.
additional_context: Composition is an active current-build resource in source/fhir.ini, and list-Composition-examples.xml still registers document-example-dischargesummary as the discharge summary example. The current XML source has http://loinc.org for the Composition type, http://snomed.info/sct for the medication coding, and http://example.org/system for the AllergyIntolerance manifestation example; the obsolete Patient identifier system is absent. Searches found no remaining exact bad values and no relevant Zulip or Confluence evidence changing the conclusion.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit on the combined branch because the requested URI corrections are already present in the current active source and the generated JSON/main examples derive from that source.
